reported.title: Blocking delay starves heartbeat
reported.description: runSirenBurst() uses delay(2000), so the loop cannot print the 250 ms 'hb' heartbeat during the siren pulse, violating the requirement to print every 250 ms and never go silent >700 ms.

reported.title: No debounce/hysteresis on door switch
reported.description: doorOpen() reads the raw pin with no debounce or settle time, so contact bounce or noise can trigger spurious siren pulses instead of requiring a settled 40 ms press.

reported.title: Siren pulse not non-retriggerable
reported.description: The sirenArmed flag is set and cleared around a blocking call and never actually gates new presses; because the loop is blocked during the pulse, presses are effectively ignored only by accident, and the design does not implement the required 'ignore presses while pulse running' state machine.

reported.title: No 150 ms response latency guarantee
reported.description: Because the sketch blocks in delay() and has no timed debounce, there is no bounded path ensuring a settled 40 ms press starts the pulse within 150 ms; the timing is uncontrolled.

judge_input.spec:
- Kiln door switch on D2 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); siren driver on D8.
- A settled door-open press as short as 40 ms starts a 2000 ms HIGH pulse on D8 within 150 ms.
- While a siren pulse is already running, additional presses are ignored (do not restart the pulse).
- Print the exact line `hb` every 250 ms at all times, including during the siren pulse.
- Firmware must never go silent (no serial and no pin change) for more than 700 ms.
- Idle door contact reads HIGH.
